newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks slightly lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: French stocks slightly lower in quiet trade.

text.p: French shares were slightly lower on Monday in busy, seesaw trading tied to the expiry of June futures and options contracts.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 9.63 points, or 0.33 percent, 9.87 points, at 2,881.56 at 0900 GMT, and the CAC-40 futures contract was down three at 2,884.

Shares in LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton were up 2.65 percent at 1,588 francs ahead of a meeting scheduled for Wednesday of the LVMH, Guinness and Grand Metropolitan chairmen to discuss differences regarding the proposed merger of the British groups in which LVMH is the largest single shareholder. "It looks LVMH won the first round," a broker said.
Shares in Renault were down 1.16 percent at 153.70 francs on profit-taking. Brokers said the closure of the Vilvoorde plant in Belgium, confirmed over the weekend, was priced into the share.
